providerDefault: OFF on Gemini 2.5 and Gemini 3 models
summary: Sets the probability at which Gemini blocks a response per harm category. A lower threshold blocks more, a higher one lets more through, so BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE is the strictest setting and OFF disables the filter for that category.
combines: Thresholds, strictest to loosest: BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH, BLOCK_NONE, OFF.
Four categories are adjustable: harassment, hate speech, sexually explicit and dangerous content. Core protections such as child safety cannot be relaxed by this field at all.
The default on current models is already OFF, so this can only tighten filtering in practice, not loosen it.
When something is blocked the image does not come back: the candidate carries finishReason SAFETY, and a blocked prompt sets promptFeedback.blockReason.
